Admission Procedure for Higher Secondary (HS) Courses
Admission Procedure for Higher Secondary (HS) Courses
Eligibility
Students who have successfully passed the
HSLC/Class X examination
from Assam State School Education Board (ASSEB)  or any other recognised Board in India are eligible to apply for admission to Higher Secondary courses, subject to fulfilment of the eligibility conditions prescribed by ASSEB  Government of Assam.
The College offers Higher Secondary courses in:
Science
Arts
Commerce
Admission will be subject to the
availability of seats, prescribed subject combinations and the rules of ASSEB/Government of Assam
.
Online Registration and Application
Admission to HS courses is carried out through the DARPAN portal designed by Govt. of Assam.
Students should:
Visit the notified HS admission portal i.e. DARPAN.
Register yourself by providing the required details.
Provide a valid mobile number and other information as required.
Select the
College
you wish to apply to.
Select your preferred
stream
—Science, Arts or Commerce.
Select the required subjects according to the available combinations.
Upload/provide the required information and documents.
Submit the application within the notified date.
Subject Selection
Students should select subjects carefully at the time of admission.
The available subjects and combinations will depend on the
stream, College, ASSEB rules and approved subject combinations
.
For example:
Science Stream
English
MIL/Alternative English
Physics
Chemistry
Mathematics
Biology
Computer Science & Application
Skill Subjects notified by ASSEB
Arts Stream
English
MIL/Alternative English
History
Political Science
Economics
Education
Logic & Philosophy
Mathematics
Computer Science & Application
Skill Subjects notified by ASSEB
Commerce Stream
English
MIL/Alternative English
Accountancy
Business Studies
Financial Literacy
Economics
Computer Science & Application
Skill Subjects notified by ASSEB
English and MIL/Alternative English are compulsory language subjects in all the streams and choosing four subjects from the list of elective subjects.
Selection of Students
After receiving applications, the College will process the applications according to:
Eligibility prescribed by ASSEB/Government of Assam
Availability of seats
Stream-wise intake capacity
Subject combination requirements
Merit, wherever applicable
Reservation rules, wherever applicable
Other instructions issued by the competent authority
The final admission process will be conducted according to the
latest official admission notification
issued by ASSEB
Publication of Selection/Admission Status
The selected/eligible students will be informed through the prescribed online portal and/or other official communication channels of the College.
Students should regularly check:
Admission portal
College website
College notice board
Official College communication channels
for admission-related notices and dates.
Document Verification
Students selected for admission must produce the required original documents for verification at the College.
Generally, students may be required to produce:
HSLC/Class X
Marksheet
HSLC/Class X
Pass Certificate
HSLC/Class X
Admit Card/Certificate
as proof of date of birth
Recent passport-size photographs
Caste certificate, if applicable
Disability/PwD certificate, if applicable
Other certificates/documents required under Government rules
Any other document specifically mentioned in the admission notification
The College may ask for additional documents wherever necessary.
Confirmation of Admission
The Admission procedure will be considered
complete only after
:
Verification of required documents;
Confirmation of eligibility;
Approval/confirmation through the prescribed admission system, wherever applicable;
Payment of admission fees (wherever applicable); and
Completion of other formalities prescribed by the College.
Students should collect/retain the
admission receipt
or other proof of admission for future reference.
Fee Payment
Students must pay the prescribed admission fees within the notified period.
Eligible students may receive benefits under applicable
Government fee-waiver/free-admission schemes
, subject to the prevailing Government rules and eligibility conditions. The Government of Assam has issued fee-waiver provisions covering Higher Secondary admissions for eligible students under its applicable scheme.
ADMISSION PROCEDURE FOR DEGREE (UG) COURSES
ADMISSION PROCEDURE FOR DEGREE (UG) COURSES
Admission to undergraduate (Degree) courses of the College is conducted through the
Samarth Admission Portal
as per the rules and guidelines of the
Government of Assam and the
Gauhati University
The College offers
B.A., B.Sc., B.Com. program (under Four Year Undergraduate Program) and three year BCA and B. Voc. program
.
Eligibility
Students who have successfully passed the
Higher Secondary (10+2) examination
from a recognised Board are eligible to apply for admission to undergraduate courses, subject to the fulfilment of eligibility requirements prescribed by the Gauhati University and Government of Assam.
Different programmes may have specific eligibility requirements and subject prerequisites.
Online Registration through Samarth
Students seeking admission to Degree courses must apply through the
Samarth Admission Portal
within the notified admission period.
The student has to:
Visit the official Samarth Admission Portal.
Register/create an account using the required details.
Enter personal and academic information correctly.
Provide a valid mobile number and other required details.
Upload the required documents.
Select the desired
College
.
Select the desired
Degree Programme
(Major program or Minor program)
Select subject preferences and other required options.
Check all information carefully.
Submit the application within the notified date.
Students should keep a copy/screenshot of the submitted application for future reference.
Selection of College and Programme
Students may select the College and programme according to the options available on the Samarth Portal.
The available programmes, subjects, Major/Minor combinations and seats will depend upon:
University regulations;
Government of Assam guidelines;
College-approved programmes;
Availability of seats; and
Approved subject combinations.
Selection of Major/Minor and Other Subjects
After selection, students have to complete the required subject selection according to the structure of the undergraduate programme.
Depending on the programme, students may have to select:
Major
Minor
Multidisciplinary courses
Ability Enhancement Courses
Skill Enhancement Courses
Value-Added/other prescribed courses
The actual course structure will be according to the
FYUGP/University curriculum applicable to the academic session
.
Students should select their subjects carefully after checking the eligibility and subject combination requirements.
Publication of Merit List
After submission of applications, students will be selected according to the
admission guidelines prescribed by the Government of Assam and the Gauhati University
.
Selection for admission will be based on merit and other prescribed criteria.
Students should regularly check the Samarth Portal and the college website for the publication of selection list/admission status.
Documents Verification
Students selected for admission must complete document verification as instructed by the College.
The following documents may generally be required:
Higher Secondary/Class XII Marksheet
Higher Secondary/Class XII Pass Certificate
Class X Marksheet/Certificate
Class X Admit Card or document showing date of birth
Recent passport-size photographs
Caste certificate, wherever applicable
PwD certificate, wherever applicable
Gap certificate, wherever applicable
Migration/Transfer Certificate, wherever required
Other documents prescribed by the University/College
Students must produce the
original documents
at the time of document verification by college authority.
Admission Confirmation
Admission will be considered complete only after the student:
Is selected/admitted through the prescribed process;
Completes document verification;
Fulfils all eligibility requirements;
Pays the prescribed admission fee, wherever applicable; and
Completes all formalities required by the College/University.
The student should retain the admission receipt and other admission-related documents for future reference.
Fee Payment
Selected students must pay the admission fee on the day of documents verification through the mode specified by the College authority.
Students eligible for any
Government fee-waiver scheme or other applicable benefits
may avail the same subject to fulfilment of prevailing Government rules and eligibility conditions.
